script:
on run argv
set inputPath to item 1 of argv
tell application "Microsoft Word"
set fixtureDoc to missing value
try
set fixtureDoc to open (POSIX file inputPath) read only true add to recent files false
set bodyText to content of text object of fixtureDoc
set details to "tables=" & (count tables of fixtureDoc) & linefeed & "footnotes=" & (count footnotes of fixtureDoc) & linefeed & "inlineImages=" & (count inline shapes of fixtureDoc) & linefeed & "firstText=" & (text 1 thru 100 of bodyText)
set resultText to "readerVersion=" & version & linefeed & "document=" & name of fixtureDoc & linefeed & details
close fixtureDoc saving no
return resultText
on error errorText number errorNumber
if fixtureDoc is not missing value then
try
close fixtureDoc saving no
end try
end if
error errorText number errorNumber
end try
end tell
end run
